summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests how rezatapopt affects the way the body processes four other drugs: metformin, rosuvastatin, repaglinide, and midazolam. It is done in people with advanced solid tumors that have a TP53 Y220C mutation. The study drugs are taken by mouth, and rezatapopt is given as 2000 mg once daily in 21-day cycles through Cycle 33 (about 2 years) or until another stop criterion is met. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; it describes collecting serial PK samples to measure drug levels in the body.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa cómo rezatapopt afecta la forma en que el cuerpo procesa cuatro otros medicamentos: metformina, rosuvastatina, repaglinida y midazolam. Se realiza en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados que tienen una mutación TP53 Y220C. Los medicamentos del estudio se toman por vía oral, y rezatapopt se administra en dosis de 2000 mg una vez al día en ciclos de 21 días hasta el Ciclo 33 (aproximadamente 2 años) o hasta que se cumpla otro criterio de suspensión. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; describe la toma de muestras PK seriadas para medir los niveles de los fármacos en el cuerpo.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who have given written informed consent.
Confirmed locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with a TP53 Y220C mutation found by an NGS test.
Patients with castration-resistant prostate cancer must be on ongoing androgen deprivation therapy or be surgically or medically castrated.
Life expectancy of at least 3 months as assessed by the investigator, with adequate organ function.
not_for: Ovarian, breast, lung, or endometrial tumor patients eligible for the PYNNACLE trial, unless that cohort is closed.
Anticancer therapy within 21 days or 5 half-lives, or radiotherapy within 14 days, before first dose.
Known significant allergy or hypersensitivity to rezatapopt, metformin, rosuvastatin, repaglinide, or midazolam.
Untreated brain or leptomeningeal metastases, spinal cord compression, or stroke or TIA within 6 months.
Uncontrolled heart disease, QTcF above 470 msec, uncontrolled hypertension, or a known KRAS SNV mutation.
